LanguageData.Gun_TOZ-66_RWP.description: The TOZ-66 is a rugged double-barreled shotgun known for its simplicity and reliability. Designed for close-quarters combat, it delivers devastating firepower with its twin barrels, capable of firing both shots in quick succession. Ideal for hunters and defenses alike, the TOZ-66 excels in tight spaces but suffers from a slower reload time.
